dedupe_keys.name: guinea health facility master data with p codes infection prevention and control cluster ebola response 2015

description: This dataset is a shared reference list built during the 2014 to 2016 Ebola response in Guinea. The Infection Prevention and Control Cluster published a world-readable Google Sheet with geographic master data for Guinea, including administrative p-codes at three levels with links to GeoJSON boundaries, a list of known health facilities, a list of partner organisations and code lists for sector (public or private) and type of infection control training. The facility list was assembled from the Guinea common operational datasets, Ministry of Health facility data and unofficial facilities reported by participating non-governmental organisations. It is HXL tagged, dated July 2015, offered as CSV exports from the sheet and free to use under a Creative Commons Attribution licence for intergovernmental organisations. Coverage is national. Caveats: HDX warns the list is incomplete because many Guinean health facilities were unregistered and official registry data were limited, and the sheet is no longer maintained. Simulation uses: facility locations and codes for outbreak response and access models in Guinea, and an example of cluster-built reference data. Related records: the Guinea Demographic and Health Survey 2018 (data-guinea-demographic-and-health-survey-2018) gives population health context.
